detail.title: Independent Judgment versus Consensus Reliability
detail.question: Under what conditions should an intelligent system trust its own independent derivation over conflicting consensus conclusions from other agents?

detail.title: Synthesis of Independent Judgment and Consensus Reliability
detail.summary: This notebook synthesizes the conditions under which an autonomous agent should prioritize its independent derivation over external consensus. It highlights how controversial domains inherently generate disagreement and how computational constraints (e.g., in search) lead to divergent outputs.
